label: Instagram Comment Scraper
title: Instagram Comment Scraper: Reels Comments to CSV
metaDescription: Extract top-level comments from public Instagram Reels without login: commenter username, text, likes and timestamp, with a per-URL limit.
intro: Paste public Instagram Reel links and get their top-level comments: commenter username, text, likes and timestamp, with pagination and a per-link limit. No login.
useCases: Measure reactions to a campaign or a creator's Reel
Pick giveaway winners from the comments
Find questions and objections your audience raises

faq.q: Is there an official Instagram comments API?
faq.a: Only for your own business or creator account's posts. This actor reads public comments on any public Reel or post without login.
Commenter username, text, like count and timestamp, with a per-link limit so you control how many you collect.

faq.q: Can I use it as a Instagram comments API?
faq.a: Yes. Start a run from your own code with Apify's REST API (or the JavaScript and Python clients) and read the results as JSON; the run-sync endpoint returns the items in the same HTTP call. The same input also runs in the Apify Console, on a schedule, or from Make, Zapier and n8n.

liveDemo.label: Instagram post or reel link
liveDemo.hint: Paste a public Instagram post or reel link and press Run: the demo fetches the first comments live (up to 10). Commenter names are hidden.

officialApi: The Instagram Graph API returns comments only for media of your own business or creator account. This actor reads the public comments under any public Reel or post.
